scenes.paragraphMeaning: Kotone and Hayato lie awake worrying about Gorō living in a stranger’s home.
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: first inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail, “New Family on the Seventh Floor,” chapter 5, after paragraph 0.
Input images: Images 1–3 are the approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings for style only; do not copy their characters or composition. Image 4 is chapter 3 art used only as a character reference for Hayato and Kotone; keep their identities and clothing palette, but do not reuse its scene or composition.
Style/medium: simple painted children’s picture-book art in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, two or three quiet depth layers, and detail simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed 12:7 landscape with readable silhouettes and one clear focal moment.
Palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, sage green, ochre gold, and restrained terracotta, adjusted naturally to the scene.
Constraints: depict only the named moment from the existing Japanese paragraph. This is a contemporary Japanese apartment building and household; use culturally appropriate, understated Japanese residential details where visible. Keep gestures gentle and plausible. No lettering, captions, readable writing, numbers, logos, signs, borders, or watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, extra people or animals, Western suburban or American-coded interiors, stereotyped Japanese props, spoilers beyond the cited paragraph, and copied Kasa Jizō characters or layouts.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet, compact contemporary Japanese apartment bedroom at night, simple bedding and a warm bedside lamp; no elaborate décor.
Subject: Kotone, twelve, with dark hair in a low ponytail, a muted teal top and indigo skirt, sits awake beside her younger brother Hayato, eight, with tousled dark hair, ivory T-shirt and sage-green shorts. Neither can sleep. Hayato looks worried as he quietly asks where Gorō will go; Kotone listens, thinking about the old dog being in an unfamiliar home. Show only the two siblings and their subdued concern. Gorō is not physically present and no imagined future home is shown.
Character continuity: match the siblings’ relative ages, height, facial features, hair, and clothing colours to Image 4. No mother or other family members in this scene.
Lighting/mood: soft low lamp light with cool indigo night at a window, tender and thoughtful, not frightening.
Composition: medium-wide view with the siblings close together in the quiet room; clear expressions, restrained shadows, no speech bubbles or visible written marks.
